question: The volume of a closed right circular cylinder of base radius 7 m is 462 m³. Total surface area of the cylinder is (Use π = 22/7):
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Volume** = πr²h ⇒ 462 = (22/7) × 7 × 7 × h ⇒ h = 3 m.

**Total Surface Area (TSA)** = 2πr(r + h) = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 3).

TSA = 44 × 10 = 440 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 440 m².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Base radius (r)** of the cylinder = 7 m

**Volume (V)** of the cylinder = 462 m³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r + h)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb739b569f048c66901744f656493f0b9be62199416bc5fe174c6c88d57995af.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = πr²h

⇒ 462 = (22/7) × 7 × 7 × h

⇒ 462 = 22 × 7 × h

⇒ 462 = 154 × h

⇒ h = 462 ÷ 154 = 3 m

⇒ TSA = 2πr(r + h)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 3)

⇒ TSA = 44 × 10

⇒ TSA = 440 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 440 m².**

**__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved part of the cylinder is given by CSA = 2πrh.

Volume of Cylinder

The space occupied by a cylinder is calculated as V = πr²h.

Base Area

The area of each circular end of the cylinder is πr². For a closed cylinder, there are two such bases.</p
